about.description: Tokenizer.Estate is a turnkey real estate tokenization platform designed for property owners, developers, and funds that want an end-to-end solution spanning legal structuring, onboarding, and a configurable token issuance workflow. It positions itself as infrastructure rather than a single asset issuer, focusing on repeatable deal setup and investor access tooling for real estate offerings.
